profile.summary: DIALOG is an architecture, engineering, interior design and planning firm with studios across Canada and the United States, including San Francisco. Its Bay Area practice includes the Oakland-based firm Byrens Kim Design Works, which joined DIALOG and works on higher education, K-12 school, civic, recreation and mixed-use projects.

sources.title: DIALOG welcomes new principals to our US operations

review.notes: Organization matches (agenda says Dialog Design, LP aka Byrens Kim Design Works; DIALOG's announcement says Oakland-based Byrens Kim joined DIALOG in 2020). However, the summary's claim that DIALOG is an engineering and interior design firm is not shown by either cited page (they show architecture, urban design and planning), so the summary is not fully supported.
